test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Suddenly, a motor bike came towards me from the opposite direction.

B. The consequence of my daredevilry was a sprained ankle and a bruised arm.

C. I was enjoying my hands-free ride at top speed.

D. I tried to swerve out of the way but lost control and fell.
solution:
The correct answer is 'CADB'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual__ connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 

__
 
• Sentence C is the independent sentence and talks about the subject enjoying something. We learn from the sentence that the subject was enjoying a 'hands-free ride at top speed' which implies that the subject was driving a motorcycle. 
 
• So, sentence C is the first sentence after rearrangement. 
 
• Sentence A talks about a sudden occurrence and sets the tone for the rest of the passage. It states how another bike came towards the subject from the opposite direction. Hence, A follows C.__
 
• Sentence **D **talks about the action taken by the subject after the sudden occurrence and hence comes in the **third position. **
 
• So, sentence B is the concluding sentence as it points out the consequences of the subject's actions. 

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is option 3 i.e. CADB.

So, the correct paragraph is : ***(******C) I was enjoying my hands-free ride at top speed. (A) Suddenly, a motor bike came towards me from the opposite direction. (D) I tried to swerve out of the way but lost control and fell. (B) The consequence of my daredevilry was a sprained ankle and a bruised arm.***
